decision: Individually exclude POD-EDIT-088 as Census data/navigation utility; preserve actual Balasore destination/spelling note, public route/data/search and distinct authored material.
scope_release: On separately reviewed merge after passing required checks; no website deployment because product unchanged.

anvesha.json.role: Anvesha independent AI source readiness; not human review
anvesha.json.rationale: This individual route is a Census district data/navigation utility: computed leading-group prose, district/residence totals, group/member tables and profile links. A real Balasore destination connection explains the Census spelling; preserve it. No sustained authored district-language narrative is attached, and no route-specific further-reading link is configured. Recommend justified single-route rollout exclusion without deleting route or importing unrelated authored material.

source.title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Odisha — 2011

actual_connections.title: Balasore
actual_connections.note: The Census table uses the spelling Baleshwar. This is district context for our Balasore guide.

search.findings: Baleshwar query produced no map hits; Balasore query and direct search locate district banking, northern destination guides, food field-study records, voices collection and culture-trails. Map spelling differences are not absence of evidence.

distinct_authored_material_preserved.scope: Fakir Mohan/Six Acres reading trail and Balasore destination links; retain separately, not Census proof of language identity.
Balasore field-study plant names with unresolved Khira-koli mapping; food/ethnobotany evidence, not district mother-tongue inference.
Separate regional visitor guide, retained with district-context link.

limits: No fresh web retrieval; saved original XLSX inspected directly and compared with public atlas input dataset.
No live-browser or deployment check; this verifies template/data, not current hosted rendering.
External sources of adjacent cultural/literary/food material not freshly inspected.
No current demographic, fluency, ancestry, migration, caste or legal-status inference. Parent and member rows are not additive.
Statewide C17 not apportioned to district.
No human/community review or blanket sibling classification.
next_actions: Coordinator may record an individually justified utility exclusion after separate review; preserve Balasore destination link and explicit Baleshwar Census naming.
Any future district-language essay needs its own sourced narrative question; preserve existing literary/food/visitor records independently.
